_about: Mages City join criteria, in registration order. Each entry is the body of one vtc/schemas/accepts/register/0.2 document. Shape follows docs/03-vtc/join-criteria.md at VTI origin/main (observed 2026-10-07); VALIDATE against the spec at the pinned revision before registering — field names here are the doc's, not a tested payload. Order matters: a criterion that requires nothing goes LAST.
_register: console: Vetting → Requirements; or a signed vtc/schemas/accepts/register/0.2 document per entry. Upstream defaults ship invited + member-credential + review; remove member-credential (no trust registry yet), then register work-evidence so the order reads invited · work-evidence · review.

criteria.description: An invitation this community issued. The City's gate issues one only after VALIDATED (understanding) and a human countersign.

Door 2, the AI path. The applicant brings an evidence root checked in their browser at join.mages.city (a City Key with its VTA record, a Star trust-task proof, or a Hitchhiker's Guide to Trust ledger) and sends it as extensions.evidence with the join request. A keeper reads the checked root, agent-assisted, and admits; approval mints membership and a mage role.

Autoresearch mage (a specialisation of door 2, opening later): evidence of research work for review, an arena run, a swarm seal or work done for others, with its chronicle. Approval mints membership and a role credential naming the lane.

Door 3, keepers, and everyone else. A keeper (of a guide and its guidance, a Hearthold, a VTC or VTA, a private knowledge network, a node of their own) or anyone else; a human decides. Pending grants nothing.

_notRegistered.member-credential: upstream default, removed: credentialIssuers=recognised needs a trust registry the City has not chosen; credentialIssuers=community would only admit existing members.
_notRegistered.vetting: peer vetting / hidden vetters: a later decision once there are members to vet.

_updated: 2026-11-17: + mage (door 2, review on a browser-checked evidence root); work-evidence becomes the autoresearch specialisation; review covers door 3 keepers. Register in this order: invited · mage · work-evidence · review.
